policy.ordering: Lowest estimated implementation effort first, then production/release proximity, then canonical game id.
policy.noCheating: Agent state must not expose hidden answer keys, unrevealed card identities, server secrets, or bypass-only state.
policy.promotion: Do not mark a game agent-ready until structured state, legal actions, telemetry/stall detection, executable agent tests, and game-specific release gates all pass.
